search.description: Search applications and system software in the software catalogue by name, type (Application / System software), supplier, licence type (Closed source / Open source) or hosting jurisdiction (NL / EU / US / Elsewhere). Use it to find which applications an organisation could adopt, or which applications a supplier offers.

get.description: Get one application by id, including its licensing, hosting jurisdiction, standards compliance and linked service offerings.

search.description: Search application versions by their application, lifecycle status (in development / in use / end of support / withdrawn) or end-of-support date. Use it to find which version of an application is current or when its support ends.

get.description: Get one application version by id, including its support dates and linked usage records.

search.description: Search service offerings by name or supplying organisation. A service is something a supplier delivers on one or more applications.

get.description: Get one service offering by id, including its supplier, linked applications and connections, and publication window.

search.description: Search organisations in the catalogue (municipalities, suppliers, collaborations, communities) by name, type, lifecycle status (Draft / Active / Inactive / merged) or registration status (pending / active / rejected).

get.description: Get one organisation by id, including its type, lifecycle status and registration state.

search.description: Find the contact persons of an organisation, or by role. Use it to answer 'who do I contact about organisation X'.

get.description: Get one contact person by id: their role and organisation.

search.description: Search connections between applications by technique (file transfer, digikoppeling, api, ...), lifecycle status, integration type (external / internal) or supplier. Use it to find how two systems exchange data.

get.description: Get one connection by id: the connected applications, the exchange direction and the supported standard versions.

search.description: Search standards-compliance records by application or GEMMA standard version, to check which applications support a given standard.

get.description: Get one compliance record by id: the evidence and reference for an application and standard pair.

search.description: Search usage records: which organisation (consumer) uses which application from which supplier, at what stage (Acquisition / Planned / In production / To be phased out / Phased out) and with which TIME classification (Tolerate / Invest / Migrate / Eliminate).

get.description: Get one usage record by id, including its timeline and linked application and contract.

search.description: Search contracts by status (Active / Expired / In negotiation), contract type (SLA / Licence / Maintenance), the service or usage they cover, or end date. Use it for questions such as 'which contracts expire this quarter?'.

get.description: Get one contract by id, including cost, term dates and its approval outcome. A contract only becomes Active through an approved decision; use stackiq.submitContractApproval or stackiq.submitContractRenewal to ask for one.

search.description: Search application suites (bundles of applications offered together) by name.

get.description: Get one suite by id, including the applications it bundles.

search.description: Search known vulnerabilities by name, CVE code, CVSS score or the applications they affect.

get.description: Get one vulnerability by id: its CVE code, CVSS score, description and affected applications.

create.description: Log a new vulnerability: name, cveCode, cvssScore (0.0 to 10.0) and the ids of the affected applications in modules (find them with stackiq.module.search).

update.description: Update a logged vulnerability, for example its CVSS score or the applications it affects.

search.description: Search reviews (assessments) of applications by moderation status (pending / approved / rejected), rating (1 to 10), reviewed application or usage. To write a review use stackiq.submitReview, which puts it up for moderation.

get.description: Get one review by id: its rating, text, author and moderation status.

search.description: Search BIO (Baseline Informatiebeveiliging Overheid) measures by code (for example 5.1.1), name or BBN level.

get.description: Get one BIO measure by id: its code, name, description and BBN levels.

search.description: Search the software components (SBOM entries) of application versions by name, application version, package URL (pkg:...) or the CVE ids linked to them.

get.description: Get one SBOM component by id: its name, version, package URL, licence and linked CVE ids.
